name: Wobbly Pim Scribblesworth
description: Wonky marker drawings of unhappy things. Every shaky line is on purpose, or at least he says so.

designs.title: Sad Ghost
designs.description: A ghost with crossed-out eyes and a single tear. Going through something. Fits behind a knee.

designs.title: Furious Cat
designs.description: A cat who has just been told something and does not agree with it. Very good on a shin.

designs.title: Pleased Cactus
designs.description: A small potted cactus with a small smile. Scribbled pot, flower on top, no idea why it is happy.

designs.title: Toothy Flower
designs.description: A cheerful daisy with far too many teeth. Do not water it after dark.

designs.title: Little Bomb
designs.description: A scribbled round bomb, fuse lit, looking delighted about it.

designs.title: Speedy Snail
designs.description: A snail at full speed, with motion lines to prove it. For someone in no hurry at all.
